events.name: Nikki Glaser: The Stunning Tour
events.info: For nearly two decades at sold-out tours, and as the host of three hit podcasts, Emmy®, Grammy® and Golden Globe®-nominated Nikki Glaser has honed her shockingly honest, no-holds barred style, solidifying herself as one of the funniest voices in comedy today. On January 5, 2025, Glaser made history as the first woman to host the Golden Globe® Awards solo. She received unanimous praise from audiences worldwide and rave reviews from critics hailing her memorable performance as ?victorious.? She is set to return as host of the 83rd Golden Globe® Awards on January 11, 2026. This October, in front of a sold-out crowd at the Fabulous Fox Theatre in her hometown of St. Louis, Missouri, Nikki taped her newest hour-long comedy special for Hulu, set to premiere in 2026. A few weeks later on November 8 she made her SATURDAY NIGHT LIVE hosting debut with musical guest Sombr. 2024 was a career redefining year for Glaser, culminating with being named ?Comedian of the Year? by The New York Times.

events.name: Lucas Oil Stadium Tour
events.info: There is no better way to add a dose of adrenaline to your next Indianapolis visit than a behind the scenes tour of this state of the art sports mecca. Tours last approximately 70-90 minutes and includes visits to the playing field, an NFL locker room, Lucas Oil Plaza, the press box, and numerous other areas that are generally inaccessible to the public. Discounted- Military, Students, Seniors 65+
events.pleaseNote: PLEASE NOTE: The NFL Clear Bag Policy will be enforced for all Public tours. All tour guests will be subject to security screening before entry into the stadium. Tours begin at the SE Entrance of the Stadium. Tour routes and times are subject to change and can be cancelled at any time. Tours last approximately 60-75 minutes. Accommodations will be made for those touring with ADA needs or with strollers. Still cameras are welcome, but video cameras are prohibited. Children 3 and under are free when accompanied by a paying adult. Private Tour information: If you are interested in a private tour please contact: tours@icclos.com

generalInfo.childRule: Varies by event. Refer to box office. For Colts games and most family events, those two and under are free and must sit on a lap. For Concerts and NCAA events, everyone needs a ticket, regardless of age.
